notes.title: Season 2 - Update 1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hello Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]With [b]Season 2 Update 1[/b], our focus is on resolving issues that should have been working correctly from the start, as well as making adjustments to a handful of other problems reported by the community.[/p][p]We also want to address the [b]Lodge [/b]issue directly: while this update does not fully fix it yet, we’ve included new data points that will surface the problem more clearly. With this in place, we’re confident we can deliver a proper fix soon.[/p][p]We appreciate your patience and understanding as we continue improving stability and overall quality. Every report and bit of feedback helps us track down these issues faster, so thank you for continuing to share your experiences with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Notorious Studios[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Campaign & Quests[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Campaign Progress[/b] would be reset if the active campaign was changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]"Get Level 25 on <Class>" quests[/b] would check the first character in the character list, instead of the highest level character of that class a player has.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]UI & Systems[/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]Prestige level text coloring[/b] to the post match screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where interactions with [b]progress bars[/b] were not displaying correctly (Revive, Give Up, Pickpocket).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Safe would shrink in size[/b] when swapping characters, potentially causing item loss.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Combat[/h2][list][*][p][b]Root effects[/b] are now fully removed when going Invisible, instead of just paused.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Classes[/h2][h3]Priest[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Priest couldn't jump or levitate[/b] while holding the sword and buckler charged attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Priest can now evade cancel[/b] out of Sword and Buckler’s Charged Attack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavens Wrath projectile speed[/b] increased by 25%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Warrior[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the [b]Axe Whirlwind attack[/b] removing its enrage effect when the input was released. notes.title: Season 2 Update: Siege of Goldbrook - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]Season 2 has officially arrived, and with it comes a full wipe. That means we’re all starting over again and we can’t wait to see the rush of new stories, rivalries, and adventures unfold from day one.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="gVFq8EnU-ZI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This season is a big step forward for [i]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery[/i]. The new Goldbrook Farmlands open up the world beyond the hub, giving both new and returning players a fresh place to explore, gather, and even fish! Campaigns bring a new sense of purpose to your journey, with questlines you can tackle your own way. Warbanners let you leave your mark wherever you’ve conquered, while fishing adds a quieter moment of discovery to your adventures.[/p][p][/p][p]For your Lodge, we’ve added the Safe, a way to keep some of your most meaningful items even after the season ends. And for those chasing progression, Prestige now lets you push past level 20 and keep climbing all the way to 99, with rewards to show for it.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to kick this off with you. The wipe is a reset, but it’s also a chance for everyone to jump back in at the same starting line and make this season their own. We’ll be there right alongside you.[/p][p][/p][p]See you all in the Farmlands,[/p][p]Notorious Studios[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Featured Changes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/22748ab43327fcb447dd1f00b3b9280a57b36c27.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Map: Goldbrook Farmlands 🌾[/b][/h3][p]Goldbrook Farmlands is now live! This new map expands the world around the existing Goldbrook region, home to the Social Hub, by introducing a beginner-friendly PvE/PvP hybrid experience.[/p][p align="start"]Designed for new players and those just starting the season, Goldbrook Farmlands is primarily focused on PvE gameplay, with about 80% of the map dedicated to PvE-only content. A smaller area in the western region is reserved for PvP, giving players the option to engage in player combat - or avoid it entirely.[/p][p align="start"]This map is also a great location for gathering low tier resources and food items such as Pumpkins, Wheat and Apples.[/p][p align="start"]Goldbrook Farmlands is a community-requested gameplay experiment, and we’re excited to hear your feedback as we continue to evolve the experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature: Campaigns 🪧[/b][/h3][p]Campaigns are a collection of quests that have multiple paths to completion. Each campaign has a theme, such as for a specific zone, class or gameplay experience.[/p][p align="start"]Players can only have one campaign active at once, but can complete all quests within the questline in any order. However, to complete the campaign you must connect the first quest in the questline to the final one to unlock the reward.[/p][p align="start"]As part of Season 2, we're excited to feature 7 campaigns, including 1 class specific questline.[/p][p align="start"]Some campaigns have premium cosmetics that are a part of our new monetization system, like a "mini battle pass." After purchasing the premium questline, you unlock all cosmetics for the quests that you have completed. After unlocking these cosmetics, you will have them forever in your collection.[/p][p align="start"]In order to advance the campaign at certain segments, players must turn-in a "Stepping Stone." Stepping Stones are granted to players sometimes when they level their characters from 1-20, or Prestige from 21-99.[/p][p align="start"]Campaign progression is also wiped each season, allowing players to re-complete the questline for rewards and experience. We recommend players always have a Campaign active while adventuring to progress optimally.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature: Warbanners 🏴[/b][/h3][p]Mark your territory during your Adventurers by placing down your Warbanner. When other players interact with your banner, they can see your House name. Warbanners are perfect to plop down on fallen enemies, or when you clear a boss just to let others know you've been there. To drop your banner, use the Emote Wheel while in an Adventure (or in the Social Hub).[/p][p align="start"]Warbanners can be customized, allowing you to change out the banner color, pole & topper and ornaments. Cosmetic options can be unlocked through Questlines, the Chronicle and more.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Experience: Fishing!🎣🐟[/b][/h3][p]You can gather Ore and Wood in Legacy, and now you can also gather Fish! To fish, simply interact (E) with any fishing pool found in your Adventures. For Season 2, these are only available in the new Goldbrook Farmlands map.[/p][p align="start"]Fishing allows you to fish up, well... fish, which can be used for crafting at the Tavernmaid for consumables to be used in your Cooking Pot in the Lodge. But fish aren't the only thing you can fish up — sometimes it can be treasures, armor or something even more exotic.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Lodge Furnishing: The Safe 🔑[/b][/h3][p]The Safe is a new Lodge Furnishing that allows players to safekeep their most cherished items acquired during the Season. These items will persist into the next Season. That's right — they won't be wiped![/p][p align="start"]The Safe can be unlocked after leveling all other Lodge Furnishings to Level 3 as well as all Vendors to Level 6 through the Chronicle.[/p][p align="start"]As with most features introduced during Early Access, the Safe is experimental —- and we welcome your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature: Prestige 🏆[/b][/h3][p]You can now progress past Level 20 into Level 99! Prestige is a cosmetic accolade, but you now earn a Stepstone when you Prestige (used for Questline progression).[/p][p align="start"]The Bed and Rested Experience also help boost how fast you Prestige.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature: The Shop (Monetization)[/b][/h3][p]Zahir Moonjade has arrived in Stonehaven, traveling from the Sea of Sands in the far East. In exchange for Dragon Teeth, he will sell you Premium Campaigns. Purchasing items from Zahir will improve your reputation with him. In the future, he will sell even more rare treasures at higher reputation levels. (Note that wipes will not reset Zahir's reputation levels)[/p][p align="start"]All proceeds from The Premium Shop will go to adding more features and content to [i]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery[/i], as well as marketing for our eventual 1.0 Gold Master release. We appreciate everyone's support on our development journey![/p][p align="start"]To visit Zahir's Shop, click the Shop button at the bottom of the main Adventure menu.[/p][p]

Our version features a spike instead of a ball, that allows the Rogue to apply whatever Affliction they chose with their Claw ability.[/p][p]This weapon features melee and midrange attacks, as well as a psudo-aerial attack. The Scorpion Tail is a great option against melee creatures or players. And that's not all — while having the Scorpion Tail equipped, Rogues can also perform a triple-jump![/p][p][/p][h3]New Lodge Furnishing: Lucky Shrine[/h3][p]When players activate the Lucky Shrine, they become blessed for their next Adventure. This feature is intended to help take the edge off of "gear fear" for newer players with low quality gear.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Feature: Leaderboards[/h3][p]See how you rank up against other players in the Leaderboards. A weekly Leaderboard as well as a seasonal leaderboard will be available. If you place on the leaderboard, you can also earn a special reward.[/p][p][/p][h3]Arena and Deathmatch Improvements[/h3][p]Alternative PvP game modes such as the Arena and Deathmatch will get a UI and system overhaul, turning the Arena into a round based experience in an improved map.[/p][p].. and more![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344320/Legacy_Steel__Sorcery/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Season 1 - Update 4 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hello Adventurers,[/p][p]This marks our final patch for Season 1. As always, we have worked hard to address as many bugs and known issues as possible, but we also want to be transparent: continued patches and hotfixes inevitably take time away from preparing for the next Season.[/p][p]If there’s something you reported that hasn’t been addressed in this update, please be assured that we’re tracking it and aim to resolve outstanding issues with the launch of [b]Season 2 next month[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Don't miss out on the MTD#22 Today to check out what's coming in our next Season.[/h3][p]Details within:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2344320/announcements/detail/512964078649475197"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Classes[/b][/h2][h3]Rogue[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Rogue's Poison Darts doing half of the intended affliction buildup[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Rogue being unable to jump while using Darts [/p][/*][/list][h3]Wizard[/h3][list][*][p]Fireball (Emberstaff normal) damage reduced by 5%.  [/p][/*][*][p]Combustion (Emberstaff Special Ability) buildup reduced by 20%  [/p][/*][*][p]Pyroblast charge time increased to 2 seconds, up from 1.5.  [/p][/*][*][p]Increased time on Wizard's Dragon's Breath cast by 6 frames  [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Wizard's skill and action window frames for the semi-charged Frostbolt.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Wizard's Dragons Breath damage area to better match it's visuals  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Wizard's Legendary Frost Orb not having gem sockets.  [/p][/*][*][p]The Wizard Frost Orb's Backwards Evade Attack will now maintain the backwards direction without player input.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Wizard could double cast Pyroblast and Meteor.  [/p][/*][*][p]Wizard's Frost Form Energy cost has been removed.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Wizard's Dark Star staff perk was not functioning  [/p][/*][*][p]Wizard's Overload Evade (while casting) can no longer be used while falling.  [/p][/*][*][p]Wizard's Mirror Images will now fire a Frostbolt when the frost orb is equipped instead of a Fireball  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Wizard's Frost Orb charged attack sounds being stuck in an unending loop if you were staggered while charging the attack.  [/p][/*][*][p]Wizard Time Warp will no longer apply its cost and cooldown when failing to activate because the target is already being time warped. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Hunter[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing Hunter's Elemental Arrows to not trigger their effect when shot at an enemy with a flying seed stuck to them. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hunter's Short Bow Tornadoes would linger for 1.5 seconds after the effect disappears.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hunter's Thunder Arrow effects to better match the aim direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of Hunter animation cancellations causing issues with grenades and traps when you jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Hunter's Frost Arrow visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hunter's Wind Arrow creating a tunnel pointing in a random direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Hunter's Sentinel Strike can no longer be interrupted by emoting. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Priest[/h3][list][*][p]Priest's Heaven's Ward, Heaven's Wrath, and Heaven's Fury with the Consecrate area of effect no longer blocks projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Priest's Mirror will now properly destroy projectiles. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Warrior[/h3][list][*][p]The Anger Mismanagement perk on the Warrior's Crescent Axe now has a stacking buff limit of 10, down from it being infinitely stacking.  [/p][/*][*][p]Warrior's Warpath can no longer be activated while the buff is already active. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Items[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Restorative Bandage is now able to be crafted  [/p][/*][*][p]The Stone Skin potion no longer gives immunity to Stuns (non-stagger)  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Class Containers (quivers, weapon harness, etc) couldn't be deleted in the in Stonehaven (Hub). [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Vendors and Lodge[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Rebuying gear from the Pawn Shop will no longer clear socketed gems  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of Treasures that were not being sold by the Sell All Treasures button  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Transmutation Device would only have 2 slots at level 3, or would lose it's 3rd slot after some time. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Creatures, World and Environment[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the Banshee screaming every 2 seconds during her idle animation.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Banshee would leash after the damage threshold was met during her Ethereal Escape ability.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Claymore Skeleton's "red attack" to actually be unblockable.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to pick up items again if you failed to pick up an item due to a full inventory.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hanging bags playing their sound effects after they've been knocked down  [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the bird sound from Red Oak tree, this sound cue should only be present for Maple and Ironwood Trees [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Updated the Suit Without a Face quest to show correct quest criteria [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Deathmatch[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Updated Deathmatch's Legendary Loadout presets.  [/p][/*][*][p]All classes now have 6x blue bandages, removing the purple bandages.  [/p][/*][*][p]Wizards additionally have 1 energy potion.  [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Deathmatch Green Ruins map's upper floor to remove the camping spot and removed a few annoying roots that were interfering with mobility. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Localization[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added French localization  [/p][/*][*][p]Updated Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank you for your continued support and feedback throughout Season 1.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Yours truly,[/b][/p][p][b][i]Notorious Studios[/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Update 4 is now available.[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344320/Legacy_Steel__Sorcery/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
[p]Hello adventurers![/p][p][/p][p]Just in time to cool things down during the summer heat, Update 3 introduces the Wizard’s new [b]Frost Orb[/b], a unique addition that brings fresh mechanics and tactical options to the class. [/p][p][/p][p]Alongside this, the update includes a range of quality-of-life improvements and balance adjustments across multiple areas of the game. As always, your feedback continues to shape the direction of Legacy, and we appreciate everyone who’s taken the time to share their thoughts. We hope you enjoy what’s new, and I see you all in Greenwood.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/713c5a25ba8e0a6287b1616c18872c71cb6626aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Text Chat[/p][list][*][p]Different game modes have different types of text chat channels. This shows as a percentage to the right of the damage numbers and displays Total Buildup on the target[/p][/*][*][p]Frostbite[/p][list][*][p]Reworked:[/p][/*][*][p]Instant damage has been removed, and stamina regeneration slowing rate has been removed[/p][/*][*][p]Now applies a 3 second Root after reaching full buildup, when the root breaks a 50% Snare is applied for 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]A debuff notes.title: A legendary Month - May Re-cap
notes.content:
[b]Season 1: Shadow’s Reach[/b] launched earlier this month and we’ve been hammering away ever since. From critical hotfixes and class tuning to map polish and backend stability, May has been a nonstop sprint to reinforce *Legacy: Steel & Sorcery* for the road ahead.

[h1]Here’s everything we packed into May:[/h1]
[h2]🌑 Season 1 Arrived[/h2]

With the launch of [b]Season 1[/b], players got access to:
[list][*] Two brand new maps: [b]Greenwood Night[/b] and [b]Dawnhammer Crypt[/b]
[*] A brand new class: [b]Wizard[/b], armed with arcane powers and chaos potential
[*] A fresh seasonal wipe
[*] Overhauled interaction systems
[*] The new[b] Goldbrook Hub, Duo Queue, Weekly Quests, and Goblin Pawn Shop[/b]
[*] New afflictions, new creatures, new loot, and [b]new ways to die gloriously[/b][/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧯 Hotfixes, Balance & Class Work[/h2]
Since launch, we’ve been dropping fast-follow hotfixes and adjustments nearly every week. Notable changes:

[*] Improved [b]performance[/b] in Greenwood’s Castle area[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙️ Crafting, Economy, and Vendor Tweaks[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed crafting bugs that started jobs with fewer items than required

[h2]⚔️ May in Review[/h2]

notes.title: Season 1 Update #1
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

With Update 1, we're rolling out key adjustments inspired directly by your feedback to make each class feel more rewarding, impactful, and fun to play. A heartfelt thank you to everyone in our community who took the time to complete our recent survey, your input has been invaluable in helping us understand your thoughts on character balance and the overall state of the game. Dive in, explore the changes, and most importantly... Enjoy the game!

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Harvest animations can now be cancelled.  A cooldown has been added to prevent rapid re-activation of harvesting.
[*] Fixed Priest chests opening backwards and not properly requiring the priest to purify the chest.
[*] Fixed an issue where teammate nameplates would not populate
[*] Fixed a number of issues where long text would not wrap
[*] Fixed an issue where the toolbelt background was still visible on the hud while it was empty
[*] Fixed an issue where the loot tracker toast would show you receiving an item you disenchanted (it was actually being destroyed)
[*] Fixed item icons hovering the wrong direction when rotated
[*] Fixed "Sell All Treasures" being enabled when you didn't have any treasures
[*] Fixed "Available Points" in the traits page being frozen if you swapped character while the page was open
[*] Fixed Upgraded Items not updating their rarity color when upgraded
[*] Fixed vendor music not playing if you entered the vendor menu via the V key

notes.content:
We're excited to have our first Season during Early Access, Season 1: Shadow's Reach that includes a full wipe.

In Shadow's Reach, you'll find 2 new maps,  [b]Dawnhammer Crypt[/b] and [b]Greenwood Night[/b]. In Dawnhammer Crypt, you'll find our first dungeon-style map that features tighter corridors in contrast to the open area of Greenwood. This map is designed for adventurers with Uncommon (Green) or higher quality gear. For Greenwood Night, we are unveiling our first nighttime version of our open-area maps that features new spawn points, extractions, loot, and creature spawning. Greenwood Night is designed for Common (White) gear and up.

We can't wait for you to check out our 5th class, [b]the Wizard[/b]! We know you've wanted Sorcery in Legacy, and it is finally here. His first weapon is the Emberstaff, which wields Fireballs you can charge up, manipulate time, and customize a larger loadout of spells through Spell Scrolls.

There is tons of new content throughout Season 1, including many improvements to the Lodg,e which adds even more progression and things to unlock during the season, class balance and updates, new creatures, and more!

We look forward to your feedback and can't wait to hear what you think!

[h1]💖 Featured Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Season 1 Wipe[/b] - All Characters, Items, Vendor Progression, etc have been wiped this season. We have also reset the House name, as well, if you wanted a rename. In future seasons, your House name will be preserved through wipes.
[*] [b]New Class: 🧙‍♂️ Wizard[/b] - The sorcery has arrived in Legacy! The Wizard is now available with their first weapon: the Emberstaff. Cast powerful spells from afar, rewind time on enemies (or allies), and search for powerful Spell Scrolls in the world to unlock new abilities.
[*] [b]New Map:[/b] 💀 Dawnhammer Crypt  - Once a revered sanctuary of the noble Dawnhammer paladins, this hallowed ground has fallen into darkness. Now, a haunted crypt crawling with Undead—and far more sinister threats—it challenges only the bravest adventurers. But for those who endure its terrors, untold riches and rare resources await within its shadowed halls.
[*] [b]New Map:[/b] 🌙 Greenwood Night  - Night falls upon Greenwood, where bandits stalk travelers, ghosts are whispered to roam, and undead grow bold and vicious. Bring a lantern - darkness invites death.
[*] [b]New Experience:[/b] [b]Goldbrook (Social Hub)[/b] - Step into Goldbrook, a free-for-all social space designed for downtime between adventures. Spar with scarecrow training dummies scattered throughout the area, challenge others to duels, or simply relax and chat with fellow players over VOIP. It’s your campfire between battles.
[*] [b]New Quest Feature: Weekly Quests[/b] - We now have quests that reset each week. The quest to kill Mor'thog has been moved from the Campaign into the Weekly Quest feature, and rewards a chance at Rare (Blue) and up quality items that previously were looted from Mor'thog's cache when slain.

[list][*] [i]Developer Note: Previously in Season 0, players could continually kill Mor'thog and have a chance at high-quality loot each time. Now, players have a weekly quest to kill him and aren't incentivized to continually "farm" him.[/i][/list]
[*] [b]New Lodge Furnishings - New furnishings[/b] have been added to the Lodge, including the Tanner, Forge, Loom, Critter Habitat, and Transmutation Device! Oh, and the Fireplace now produces Charcoal when you burn your wood.
[*] [b]New Feature: Goblin Pawn Shop [/b]- Sneer now will sell some of the items you lose during Adventurers back to you... for a modest price. (As long as they haven't been looted by other players)
[*] [b]New Creatures:[/b] You'll find the Bandit, Spear Skeleton, Necromancer, Banshee, and Arcane Eye around Greenwood Night and the Crypt.
[/list]


[h1]Full Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h3]🗒️ General Changes[/h3]
[list][*][b]New Feature: Lanterns -[/b] You can now craft a lantern that can be equipped in your toolbelt. The Lantern can be used during adventurers to illuminate dark areas. Can be turned off and on.
[*][b]New Queue Type: Duo Queue[/b] - Duo Queue is now available for Greenwood Day and Greenwood Night.
[*][b]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery Founders Edition[/b] now includes 1 additional Character Slot. This feature is a permanent feature.
[*][b]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery God-Tier Edition[/b] now includes a new Priest and Rogue hairstyle as well as a new Wizard hair color.
[*]Interaction System
[list][*]Interaction Hotkey now hovers over the interactable object in world space rather than 2D in the UI
[*]Camera targeting for interactables has been improved to better help you select interactable objects when they are close together[/list]
[*]Consumables such as healing potions, bandages, class tools (i.e. smoke bomb) can no longer be placed in your Inventory (backpack) when queuing for an adventure, and must be stowed in their respective toolbelts.

[list][*] [i]Developer Note: This change is intended to address the issue where players will bring in too many consumables which can make combat encounters — in particular, PvP ones — stagnate. In exchange, we have approximately doubled the stack size of most consumables. Consumables are intended to be a scarce resource that adventurers should prepare and maintain wisely during sessions. This change will also make higher tier (rarity) toolbelts more valuable and interesting, as intended. We understand that this change will affect the game at the high-end, and will evaluate how this change affects the game and make changes where necessary.[/i][/list][/list]

[h1]⚔️ Combat[/h1]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] [b]New Status Effect: Silence[/b] - Prevents the player from using any weapon attacks, weapon skills, blocking, or using any class skills or class tools.
[list][*] [i]Developer Note: We are shifting some Stuns on player and creature abilities to instead be Silence. The goal with Silence to be a softer version of a stun, allowing us to make more appropriate status effects to some abilities.[/i][/list]
[*] [b]New Damage Type: Lightning[/b] - Damage type of some Wizard spells, Arcane Eye (Creature), Shock Beetle (Hunter), etc.
[*] Resilience[list][*] Fixed an issue where the character did not remain immune to all CC's during the Resilience state
[list][*] [i]Developer Note: Resilience is a rare status effect that automatically triggers when the player is afflicted by too much stun/stagger in a short amount of time.[/i][/list][/list]
[*] Evade[list][*] Fixed an issue where mid-to-high latency players would spend stamina on a failed evade [/list][/list]

[h3]Afflictions[/h3]
[list][*] [b]New Affliction: Combustion[/b] - When triggered, will cause the target to explode, dealing damage and Combustion buildup to themselves and other nearby enemies of the caster.
[*] [b]New Affliction: Stasis[/b] - When triggered, will Stun the target for a short duration and cause Lightning damage.
[*] All players who contribute Affliction buildup to a creature will now properly see damage numbers, rather than just the player who triggered the Affliction last[/list]

[list][*] Increased Enrage duration to 3 seconds, up from 2[/list]

[list][*] Now Silences the target instead of Incapacitating them for the same duration of 4 seconds

[list][*] You become Unstoppable and your movement speed increases by 50% for 3 seconds.  The first attack you deal during Warpath will break you out, but its damage is increased by 20%.[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Mace & Spiked Shield[/b]
[list][*] Headbutt (Evade Attack) causes a Silence for 1 second
[*] Jump Attack causes a 30% snare for 2 seconds[/list]
[b]Axe[/b]
[list][*] Whirlwind now applies the Enraged effect[/list]
[b]Deathball[/b]
[list][*] Adjusted hitbox of the third normal attack[/list]
[h3]Traits[/h3]

[list][*] Using Mace + Shield = Increases Armor by 5%

[b]Stealth[/b]

[h3]Skills[/h3]

[list][*] Root time reduced to 3 seconds, down from 4[/list]

[list][*] Pushed back hit frames on the Evade Attack to frame 4, up from frame 0

[b]Daggers[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where casting Spider Bite while jumping did not consume adrenaline[/list]

[list][*] Fixed an issue where the dart equip animation could be used to cancel anything[/list]
[b]Paralyzing Dart[/b]
[list][*] Now applies a Silence for 6 seconds instead of an Incapacitate effect[/list]

[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
[b]Evade[/b]
[list][*] Increased the duration of Evade frames during the animation to 17, up from 10
[*] Reduced the amount of recovery frames before the hunter can move again by 50%[/list]
[h3]Skills[/h3]

[list][*] Reduced damage to self from explosions by 90%

[list][*] Eagle Stance weapon skill replaced with Thunder Arrow

[h3]Traits[/h3]

[list][*] Increase movement speed by 70% for 0.5 seconds after performing an Evade[/list]

[list][*] Knocks back targets an additional 2 meters

[h3]Perks[/h3]

[list][*] Reworked perk to: Your Thunder Arrow deals 30% Lightning buildup[/list]

[h3]Skills[/h3]
[b]All Stars[/b]
[list][*] Reduced damage dealt to self from stars by 90%[/list]
[b]Heaven's Fury[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Heaven's Fury would spawn underground when holding it and targeting over Characters
[*] Lingering Consecrate area now deals damage over time instead of Penitence buildup[/list]
[b]Heaven's Ward[/b]
[list][*] Reworked - You turn into pure Holy light, becoming immune to all damage and effects while increasing your movement speed by 30%. When Heaven's Ward ends, you deal damage and stun all enemies in an area.[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Scepter[/b]
[list][*] Charged Attack now applies 10% penitence per projectile
[*] Added an Evade Attack, The Scepter fires the first normal attack 25% faster and deals 25% more damage
[*] Healing now scales with weapon rarity[/list]
[b]Staff[/b]
[list][*] Added an evade attack, The Staff fires the first normal attack 25% faster and deals 25% more damage[/list]
[b]Sword and Buckler[/b]
[list][*] Charged Attack now generates 50% Penitence[/list]
[h3]Class Tools[/h3]
[b]Prayer Card - Mending[/b]
[list][*] Added a new Prayer Card, Mending, cures 50% of Wound damage[/list]
[b]Cleanse[/b]
[list]
[*] Cleanse can now remove the following additional effects:
[list][*] Incapacitate
[*] Roots
[*] Snares
[*] Fire and Lightning afflictions
[*] Affliction buildup over time effects
[*] Phantom dagger DoT + tag effect
[*] Added a 1-minute Cooldown[/list][/list]
[h3]Traits[/h3]
[b]Contrition - New Trait[/b]
[list][*] Added a new trait, Contrition, gives the Priest a 25% chance to land a critical hit against targets afflicted by Penitence[/list]
[b]Holy Sparks[/b]
[list][*] No longer spawn from the Heaven's skills
[*] Spawns when the Star Burst Trait is activated
[*] Does not get consumed by allies for healing
[*] Maximum limit of only 3 being able to be spawned at a time
[*] Applies a Silence for 2 seconds to enemies instead of a Stun[/list]
[b]Penance - New Trait[/b]
[list][*] When you deal a critical hit, you generate 10 Energy[/list]
[b]Evading Light - New Trait[/b]
[list][*] Evade attacks generate 10 energy. If an enemy is afflicted by Penitence, it will deal Critical Damage.[/list]
[h3]Perks[/h3]
[b]Battlepriest's Lightguard[/b]
[list][*] Fixed Reflective Shell perk to reflect a portion of damage dealt to the Priest during the effect of spirit shell[/list]

[b][u][h2]Wizard[/h2][/u][/b]
Wizard is live. He currently has a fire staff weapon available with another weapon to follow very soon.


[h1]🌳 World[/h1]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Harvestable objects, such as trees and ore nodes, will now toss out gatherable items when harvested.
[list][*] [i][b]Developer's Note[/b]: This is our attempt to make the gathering systems a bit more immersive and dynamic. Let us know what you think![/i][/list][/list]
[h3]Greenwood[/h3]
[list][*] Various regions of Greenwood have received additional level art passes and polish
[*] Greenwood Dungeons and Stonehill have received a full art pass
[*] Greenwood now has localized volumetric fog throughout
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would get awkwardly stuck in the river in Greenwood[/list]
[h3]Goldbrook Social Hub[/h3]
The Goldbrook Social Hub is intended to be a free-for-all space where players can test their gear on test dummies, organize duels amongst each other or just socialize through VOIP. This is an experimental mode that the Legacy has requested: Steel & Sorcery community.
[list][*] Players spawn at the Chapel, while inside the boundaries of the chapel and it's surrounding platform, the Sanctuary buff is applied, preventing the players from taking any damage, or using any attacks or actions other than Emotes
[*] Once players step outside the Sanctuary zone, they can freely attack one another
[*] If a player is downed they will automatically revive on the spot after 6 seconds
[*] The map is a Bring Your Gear mode
[*] Items dropped on the map will disappear
[*] Items used/dropped while in the map will be restored upon leaving
[*] Players can leave the map through the Extraction zone across the bridge or by using the Leave Game option in the Escape menu
[*] Players can only queue for this mode Solo for now, we plan to expand it to allow for parties in the future[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/e5a2667e366ca9d790dd4c74c8553eb245d1004d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Greenwood Night[/h3]
Greenwood Night is a nighttime version of Greenwood. It is tuned for players with Common (White) gear and above.
[list][*] New and increased loot and resource nodes (Wood, Ore) of higher quality than normal Greenwood
[*] New and different player extracts than normal Greenwood
[*] Different encounters and creatures for the player's experience[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/0f7766f0f71dcc282ffb9491f4e2a3701ef00f47.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dawnhammer Crypt[/h3]
Dawnhammer Crypts is a new dungeon-style map meant for smaller corridor gameplay. For Season 1, it is intended to be the most hardcore experience in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/96919ccdc7f1aca1ed96046fff9381130ebc29a6.jpg[/img]

[h1]🔧 Items & Progression[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where you would consume rested experience on max level characters
[*] Items looted that can be stowed into Specialized Soul Pouches will be done so at a higher priority than your Inventory
[list][*][i] [b]Developer Note:[/b] This is a quality of life change that will, for example, place Ore when looted into your Ore Soulbound Pouch rather than your main backpack. Soulbound Pouches can store items that, when killed during an adventure, will remain with you.[/i][/list]
[*]Toolbelts (Non-class) have had their storage capacity increased by 1[/list]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list][*] New Weekly Quest bucket added that features quests that reset each week.
[*] The Campaign questline now has 9 new quests that unlock each week, starting Week 1 of the Season up until Week 9.
[list][*] [i][b]Developer's Note:[/b] Each week a new quest will unlock on the campaign after Quest #12. Some of these quests reward items required to upgrade Lodge furnishings to higher levels.[/i][/list]
[*] The "Mor'thog Must Die" quest has been moved from the Campaign into the Weekly Quest bucket
[/list]

[h1]👛 Vendors & Lodge[/h1]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*] You can now sell items that do not have a sell price.  You'll receive nothing from the sale.
[*] Improved the network performance of vendor crafting recipes
[*] Fixed some recipes, such as the ogre king crate, consuming too many items when crafting.[/list]
[b]Goblin (Sneer)[/b][list][*] [b]New Feature: Pawn Shop[/b] - The Pawn Shop will contain a selection of items that you were wearing when you departed into an ill fated adventure where you died.  Not all of your items are returned to you.  Sneer's goblin friends are only able to recover some of your items you lost.[/list]
[b]Lodge[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Furnishing: Critter Habitat[/b] - Place Critters into the Habitat that produce some interesting items, some very lucrative...!
[*][b] New Furnishing: Transmutation Device[/b] - A mysterious crating box that creates unpredictable results.  Find it's recipes during adventures!
[*] [b]New Furnishing: Tanner[/b] - Converts your Leather Scraps (along with some Grub Oil) into Leather.
[*][b] New Furnishing: Loom[/b] - Converts Tattered Cloth (along with some thread) into Cloth.
[*] [b]New Furnishing: Forge[/b] - Converts your Ore (along with Charcoal, that comes from the Fireplace when it burns wood) into Bars.
[*] Fireplace
[list][*] The Fireplace has been reworked to burn different types of wood, leaving behind various crafting items for you to make use of.[/list][/list]
[h1]🖱️ UI/UX[/h1]
[b]Lodge[/b]
[list][*] New Lodge modules
[list][*] Forge
[*] Tanner
[*] Loom
[*] Critter Habitat
[*] Transmutation Device[/list]
[*] Fireplace Lodge module now has an item grid that will be used to consume wood rather than manually selecting how many pieces of wood you want to consume
[list][*] Mode types of wood than just Chopped Wood can be used in the fireplace[/list]
[*] Moved Lodge into its own screen instead of being a tab at the top of the lobby screen
[*] Added "L" hotkey to open the lodge directly while in the lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where the Ossuary timer could sometimes be empty
[*] Fixed a bug with the Cooking Pot slots not having tooltips[/list]
[b]Vendors[/b][list]
[*]Enchantress
[list][*] Fixed a bug where additional gems would be consumed when trying to socket multiple gems into different sockets without reloading the Socketing page
[*] Fixed the refresh timer for Enchantress showing negative values[/list]
[*]Treasurer
[list][*] Added pawn shop[/list]
[*] Added more vendor animations to all vendors, including idle animations
[*] Adjusted scaling for vendor backgrounds for non 16:9 aspect ratio screens
[*] Added a grace period to all vendor actions to prevent accidental duplicate actions
[*] All items can now be sold at vendors, but items that were previously unsellable are worth 0 gold and 0 glint
[*] Fixed a bug where quick selling (Ctrl + Click on an item) was not marking an item for sell when taking you to the Sell tab of the current vendor[/list]
[b]Lobby[/b]
[list][*] Fixed multiple instances of being able to get into the lobby with an invalid character (subsequently soft locking you when you got into game)
[*] Disable all UI except for the Cancel Matchmaking button when in matchmaking
[*] Fixed layout on the Character and Class Select screens
[*] Queue restrictions
[list][*] You cannot queue without a weapon equipped
[*] You cannot queue for an adventure with a gear requirement if you don't meet the requirement
[*] You cannot queue with additional consumables in your backpack/soul pouch
[*] Warning when queueing solo/duo into a mixed queue[/list]
[*] Added Time of Day and Gear Requirement to the map select info panel
[*] Fixed your team size/mode not switching from Solo to Mixed when you create/join a party
[*]Quests
[list][*] Added weekly quests
[*] Campaign quests that aren't available yet due to a time or event restriction will now display that information on the campaign page[/list][/list]
[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list][*] Added hotkeys showing you what keys to press for basic actions when in the Tutorial
[*] New loading screen tooltips[/list]
[b]WIP Localization Support (Experimental)[/b]
[list][*] Chinese, Japanese, Spanish (Spain)[/list]
[h1]🔊 Audio[/h1]
[h3]⚔️ Combat Clarity & Awareness[/h3]
[list][*]New combat audio system prioritizes threat, direction and proximity, helping players “listen forward.”
[list][*]Enemy attacks and movement now sound louder and clearer when they're in your field of view.
[*]All abilities are slightly more audible when in the player's FOV
[*]Friendly footsteps and actions are softened to help you better track threats from teammates
[*]Enemy foley and abilities behind your camera FOV are now muffled and pitched slightly down, and given a blur[/list][/list]
[h3]🧙‍♂️ Wizard, Class Updates, Priest Exertions[/h3]
[list][*] Significant audio updates to dozens of class abilities, variants added, volume adjusted for balance
[*] New suite of abilities for Wizard Class
[*] Priest exertions updated based on player community feeback![/list]
[h3]🌲 Environment[/h3]
[list][*] End-of-match ambience now lowers as extraction completes.
[*] Greenwood Night ambience and variants added for specific zones and areas.
[*] Crypts ambience and geometry created to support internal spatial audio
[*] New music added for boss encounters and new levels.
[*] Ambient loops now play consistently indoors and in vertical spaces.
[*] Riverbed surfaces configured to play water footsteps correctly[/list]
[h3]🐍 Creatures[/h3]
[list]New enemies with sounds for creature exertions and abilities
[list][*] Banshee
[*] Skeleton Spearman
[*] Skeleton Necromancer
[*] Arcane Eye
[*] Bandit[/list][/list]
[h3]🔊 Voice Chat & Player Sounds[/h3]
[list][*] Voice chat now [b]has smoother processing and should be much clearer.[/b]
[*] Realtime processing:[list][*] Input levels and peaks have been tuned to reduce distortion and overlap.
[*] Voice input applies environmental reverb, making team comms feel embedded in the world.
[*] More features in the future will include realtime voice processing based on player state
[list][*] Priest muffled slightly while blocking inside their bubble shield
[*] Echo/reverb while Enraged as a warrior
[*] High-pitched while under the effects of jumping potion
[*] 'And many more!'[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]🎧 UI & UX[/h3]
[list][*] New UI SFX for stamina depletion, out-of-money alerts, loot crate opens, and more.
[*] Priest hover now drains stamina audibly when sustained, pitching downward.
[*] Critical Hit sound now highlights when players deal special damage
[*] Fixed several cases where the ability activation failure audio would spam on repeat
[*] Various bug fixes and other audio enhancements[/list]

notes.title: Meet the Devs Episode 15: The Wizard Reveal

notes.title: Early Access - Hotfix #8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Players who are banned will now see information related to their ban, rather than be stuck in an infinite loading screen
[*] Fixed an issue where items on cooldown could be dropped
[*] Crash Fixes
[*] Players can no longer move or drop bags or toolbelts if there is a movement restriction (such as item on cooldown) applied to an item in that bag or toolbelt
[*] Reduced the effectiveness of sprint efficiency on gems. Was 10/15%, now 8/10%
[*] Raw Carrots now grant Max Stamina instead of Sprint Efficiency
[*] Tomatoes now grant Rot Resistance instead of Sprint Efficiency 
[*] Increased the effectiveness of Stamina Regeneration gems.  
[*] Fixed issue that caused Warrior's Iron Grip tap to not be restored to the distance of 10 meters
[*] Priest's Ascend perk can no longer be activated when the Priest is out of stamina
[*] Priest Mirror's hitbox has been made larger to better cover the lower part of the mirror
[*] Fixed Rogue's dagger evade attack not removing the Rogue from stealth
[*] Rogue Claws, Blade Rush, Hunter's Shortbow Windstrike, and Priest's Sword and Buckler's Weapon Skill can now be used while sprinting.  
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Hotfix #7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Gems giving their bonuses to players based on the item level of the parent item, not the gem itself.
[list][*] Gems will now give the stats they say they give.[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Dormant AI would get stuck in dormancy if they were stunned or hit reacted while dormant
[*] Fixed an issue where players would lose the ability to jump if they were rapidly jumping in high latency situations
[*] Fixed some abilities applying their resource costs inconsistently
[*] Fixed Snare effects scaling the movement of Mantle
[*] Fixed Traits not working after respawning in Deathmatch
[*] Fixed an issue where Blade Rush could summon multiple phantoms for the Dunestalker perk if animation canceled by Phantom Veil
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Warrior[/b][/u][/h2]
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[b]Iron Grip[/b]
[list][*] Increased the distance of the fully charged version to 20 meters, up from 15[/list]
[b]Battle Frenzy[/b]
[list][*] Attempted fix at Battle Frenzy still not breaking the player out of Incapacitate[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Axe[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed hit reaction from the Giant's Guillotine aftershock damage
[quote]Developer Note: The goal of Giant's Guillotine  is more damage, but was becoming used more as a way to chain stun unintentionally.[/quote]
[/list]
[b]Mace and Spiked Shield[/b]
[list][*] Attempted fix at the Quake weapon swapping[/list]
[h3]Class Tools[/h3]
[b]Sickle[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Wound and Missing Health damage scalars by 30%
[quote]Developer Note:  The long-term goal with this ability is to have a cooldown, but this is tricky for us to implement in a hotfix at the moment so we are temporarily reducing its effectiveness by a large margin.[/quote]
[/list]
[u][b][h2]Hunter[/h2][/b][/u]
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[b]Cyclone[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased cooldown to 8 seconds
[quote]Developer Note:  We love that Cyclone has been a popular choice for Hunters and creates a lot of exciting gameplay moments, but its frequency and ease of use is a bit too high which can cause Hunters to "kite" too easily.

We've been adjusting the cooldown and observing changes, and will continue to adjust until we feel like its right. Previously the cooldown was 5, and now we are adjusting to 8 sec.
[/quote]
[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Swift Bow[/b]
[list][*] Fixed the swift bow Evade Attack not consuming special arrows[/list]
[u][b][h2]Priest[/h2][/b][/u]
[h3]Skills[/h3]
[b]Gleaming Star[/b]
[list][*] Damage increased by 30%[/list]
[b]Guided Star[/b]
[list][*] Damage increased by 6.5%[/list]
[b]Bouncing Star[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage increased by 10% on the explosion and bounce hits
[quote]Developer Note:  We want to create an interesting decision between Heaven's Fury and the Stars, as well as encourage them to be used as a combo together. Heaven's Fury (and its alternates) are great choice because of its strong stun, and we'd like to encourage more use of the Stars because of its damage, so we are increasing its damage.[/quote]
[/list]
[b]Heaven's Ward[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Heaven's Ward was not costing Energy[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[b]Scepter[/b]
[list]
[*] Restored the total follow distance of charged Scepter projectiles to 45 meters, up from 30
[quote]Developer Note:  The Scepter Charge Attacks (Press and Hold), like many mechanics in Legacy during Early Access, are a work in progress design. Currently, the Charged Attack (called Light Array Volley) will home onto targets, following them around terrain and the environment until they deal damage. If a player Evades, the projectile will fizzle and won't continue to follow the player.

We are adjusting with the distance and power of this effect, but based on your feedback have realized that a mid-season hotfix isn't the right time to experiment with this and are reverting it back.[/quote]
[/list]
[h3]Traits[/h3]
[b]Redemption[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Redemption to once again restore 30% of the target's max HP on reviving a downed player
[/list]
[b]Star Burst[/b]
[list]
[*] Attempted fix at an issue where Heaven's Ward and Heaven's Wrath Consecration areas would not work with the Star Burst traits
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Update #2
notes.content:
[b][h1]🗒️General Changes[/h1][/b]
[list][*]You can now delete and rename characters by right-clicking on the character select screen
[/list][b][h1]⚔️Combat[/h1][/b]
[b][h3]AI[/h3][/b]
[list][*]Enemies will now always try to return back to their spawns at maximum leash range.
[list][*]This should feel like enemies have a shorter leash range.
[/list][*]Fixed an issue where taunted Enemies would remain attacking the downed player who taunted them
[*]Fixed an issue where some Enemies would consider downed or dead targets as threats
[*]Fixed an issue where Enemies would change targets in the middle of an ability
[*]Mor'Thog's goblin allies will now wait for Mor'Thog to call them
[/list]
[b][h3]Weapon Swapping[/h3][/b]
[list][*] When switching weapons through the Inventory, the Cooldown of Weapon Skills will activate, and refresh
[quote]Developer Note: Switching weapons mid-fight through the inventory screen is unintended gameplay that we don't expect every player to master in order to succeed. It is also intended to be a unique trait for the Warrior class. This is the start of figuring out how to discourage this type of gameplay.
[/quote][/list]
[b][h3]Afflictions[/h3][/b]
[b]Hemorrhage[/b]
[list][*]Doubled the time per tick
[*]Doubled damage per tick
[/list]
[b]Frostbite[/b]
[list][*]Reduced Max Health Frostbite damage to 25%, down from 30%
[*]Limited the maximum damage frostbite can deal when applied to Huge targets to 5% of Max Health, instead of 25%
[/list]
[b][h1]🧙‍♀️Classes[/h1][/b]
[b][h3]General[/h3][/b]
[list][*]Fixed several bugs that could cause players to get stuck in a slow walk state.
[*]Auto Run is now cancelled when interacting with a loot chest.
[quote]Developer Note: We're aware of the source of this issue; a more systemic fix will be added in a future patch.
[/quote]
[*]Block now breaks when the value hits zero, fixing issues with being able to hold it indefinitely at zero
[/list]
[b][h2][u]Warrior[/u][/h2][/b]
[b][h4]Mechanics[/h4][/b]
[b]Enrage[/b]
[list][*]Reduced bonus damage during Enrage to 10%, down from 15%
[/list]
[b][h4]Skills[/h4][/b]
[b]Iron Grip[/b]
[list][*]Reduced tap distance to 7.5 meters, reduced the fully charged distance to 15 meters
[/list]
[b]Battle Frenzy[/b]
[list][*]Now removes Incapacitate on cast as described
[/list]
[b]Raging Shout[/b]
[list][*]Changed the Unstoppable aura to an Unblockable one to better indicate that the status effect application pierces block
[*]Fixed an issue where the Incapacitate effect was piercing Evade frames
[/list]
[b]Chain Pull[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a white box appearing when using Chain Pull
[/list]
[b][h4]Weapons[/h4][/b]
[b]Deathball[/b]
[list][*]Unstoppable has been removed from the first two normal attacks
[*]Slightly reduced the width of the Evade Attack hitbox
[*]Removed the Incapacitate effect from the Evade Attack when hitting targets into an object
[/list]
[b]Axe[/b]
[list][*]Slowed down the Light Power Attack by 20%
[*]Decreased damage of the Light Power Attack by 20%
[*]Slowed down Heavy attacks 2 and 3 by 10%
[*]Fixed an issue where the Axe appeared to have 8 Block
[*]Reduced the Flatten time on the full charged Heavy attack to 1 second, down from 1.75 seconds
[/list]
[b]Mace & Shield[/b]
[list][*]Reduced physical damage reduction stat increase to 1% per tier, down from 2%
[*]Spread out the hemorrhage buildup on the mace and shield normal attacks instead of all of it being on the final shield hit, they are now as follows
[list][*]Attack 1 - 75 buildup
[*]Attack 2 - 100 buildup
[*]Attack 3 - 125 buildup
[*]Attack 4 - 300 buildup
[/list][*]Fixed an issue where the quake aftershock would occur after switching weapons (which means you no longer have the Perk active)
[*]Fixed an issue where quake after shock would happen after cancelling the skill, before the impact happened
[*]Improved the performance of the Quake VFX
[/list]
[b][h4]Traits[/h4][/b]
[b]Executioner[/b]
[list][*]Reduced damage per ear from 10% to 2%
[*]Increased stack limit to 5
[/list]
[quote]Developer Note: This trait was overtuned and had to be brought down. We are continually to monitor Executioner and will make more adjustments as necessary.
[/quote]
[b]Anchored Chain[/b]
[list][*]Taking any action will cancel the window for activating the anchored chain
[*]Anchored chain animation now has a queue for actions
[*]Cancelling out of the anchored chain animation should happen at the end of it
[*]Fixed the tether appearing as a white box
[/list]
[b]Killing Spree[/b]
[list][*]Rage gained is now different values depending on the difficulty of the enemy killed as follows
[list][*]Normal Mob - 20 Rage
[*]Elite Mob - 30 Rage
[*]Player - 40 Rage
[*]Special Mob - 60 Rage
[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Killing Spree was getting triggered from destroying Beetles, Sentinel Birds, Divine Mirrors, and any Destructibles
[/list]
[b]Pain Management[/b]
[list][*]Percentage of max health applied as an absorb shield reduced to 10%, down from 15%
[/list]
[b][h4]Perks[/h4][/b]
[b]Bonecracker Shoulders[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Charge distance was getting increased with the shoulders
[/list]
[b]Ironspike Menace[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the Iron Grip distance increase to be 50% instead of 100% as described
[/list]
[b]Skullcrusher Deathball[/b]
[list][*]Fixed tooltip to display 25% crit chance
[/list]
[b][h2][u]Rogue[/u][/h2][/b]
[b][h4]Mechanics[/h4][/b]
[b]Evade[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Long Evade would combo into another Long Evade, instead of the Short one
[/list]
[b]Teleport Effects[/b]
[list][*]Teleports no longer remove Roots, but the teleport still works
[/list]
[b]Pickpocket[/b]
[list][*]Pickpocket is now disabled on invisible targets
[*]Fixed an issue where players could duplicate items using Pickpocket
[/list]

[list][*]Invisibility increased to 2 seconds, up from 1

[b]Phantom Veil[/b]

[list][*]Adrenaline increased to 4 granted after landing the grapple, up from 3

[b]Smoke Bomb[/b]

notes.title: Developer Update: Help for Common Issues and Launch Day Update!
notes.content:
[i]Well Met, Players![/i]

[i]Thank you so much for your interest in Legacy: Steel & Sorcery. As much as we wanted to have a completely smooth launch yesterday, we unfortunately had a few issues that affected the experience for many of you, and for that, we're very sorry. We spent the entire day deploying fixes, and we're happy to share that the two biggest issues yesterday — [b][b]1) server connection issues[/b][/b] and [b][b]2) an[/b][/b] [b][b]audio memory leak ("crackling")[/b][/b] were resolved before the end of the day [i]🥳[/i].[/i]

[i]Today, we continue to be focused on stabilizing and deploying fixes to smoothen the experience for all of you. In this post we will detail out the top issues we're seeing, and what you can do to resolve them.[/i]

[i]We're also working on a smaller patch that will include two new servers: [b]Oceania[/b] (Sydney) and [b][b]South America[/b][/b] (Sao Paulo). Additionally, we are moving our Asia server from Singapore to Seoul to better serve our community in the region. We hope to have this deployed within the next 48 hours.[/i]

[i]We are also focused on resolving further crashes, connection issues and including some quality-of-life fixes such as saving your default queue preference in the Adventure ("main menu") screen.[/i]

[i]Thanks again for your support, and we apologize for all of the inconvenience. We will have more updates for you soon, in the meantime you can stay connected on Discord or follow us on X.[/i]

[i]We hope to see you in Greenwood![/i]

[i][b]Chris Kaleiki[/b][/i]

[i][b]Founder, CEO[/b][/i]
[i][b]Notorious[/b][/i]


[h1]Common Issue #1: The Game Crashes[/h1]

Our team has been hard at work looking through your crash logs and deploying fixes for various crashes. The following three are the cause for up to 90% of the crashes we're seeing:

[h2]1️⃣ Common Crash #1: Intel 13th & 14th Gen CPUs[/h2]

[h3]The Issue[/h3]

There’s a known microcode bug that requires a BIOS update. If your crash mentions decompression, updating your BIOS should resolve it. For more information on this issue, please [url=https://community.intel.com/t5/Blogs/Tech-Innovation/Client/Intel-Core-13th-and-14th-Gen-Desktop-Instability-Root-Cause/post/1633239]read this article from Intel.[/url]

[h3]✨ How to Fix It[/h3]

Follow [url=https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/gaming/resources/how-to-update-bios.html]these instructions from the Intel website[/url] , or check out this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fEm03X0bQVY]clip on YouTube[/url] on how to update your BIOS.

[h2]2️⃣ Outdated NVIDIA Overlay Driver (NVIDIA Users!)[/h2]

[h3]The Issue[/h3]

An outdated GeForce Overlay can cause a GPU/DirectX-related crash. Make sure your GeForce Experience app is up to date.

[h3]✨ How to Fix It[/h3]

Follow the following steps, or [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXF0VorZRZ4]check out this helpful YouTube video[/url] we found.

[list=1]
[*]
Open GeForce Experience

[list]
[*]Press `Win +S` and search for GeForce Experience
[*]Click on it to launch the app
[/list]
[*]
Update GeForce Experience

[list]
[*]Click on the [b]Settings (gear icon)[/b] in the top right
[*]Go to the [b]General[/b] tab and check for available updates
[*]If an update is available, install it
[/list]
[*]
[b]Update Your Graphics Driver[/b]

[list]
[*]Navigate to the [b]Drivers[/b] tab
[*]Click [b]Check for updates[/b]
[*]If a new driver is available, click [b]Download[/b] and then [b]Express Installation[/b]
[/list]
[/list]


[h2]3️⃣ "GPU Crash Dump Triggered" Error[/h2]

[h3]The Issue[/h3]

This can be fixed by changing your DLSS settings from FSR to DLSS/DLAA in-game.

[h3]✨ How to Fix It[/h3]

This can be fixed by changing your DLSS settings from FSR to DLSS/DLAA in-game.

[b]Here's how to do it:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Go to the [b]Settings Menu[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/93b3eee07fa4d73488ab0cfab49cc7b33e06060c.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][b]Click Video[/b] to show Video settings
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/08007ee1d612341b9a8dd7bcd10b237ae53e1404.png[/img]


[list=1]
[*]Change [b]Super Resolution Mode[/b] from FSR to [b]DLSS/DLAA[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/e16358bc96242bd3c0cbf34513715d5049f6155d.png[/img]

[h2]4️⃣ Other Crash[/h2]

Over [b]90% of the crashes we’re receiving fall into categories #1-3[/b], but if these don’t apply to you, then you may have an unrelated crash that we need to investigate personally. We’re happy to troubleshoot with you, so don’t hesitate to reach out!

[h4]If your game crashes and you see the "Crash Reporter" window, you’re good![/h4]

Rest assured, submitting the report through that system helps us gather critical data to deploy a fix if needed.

[h4]If your game crashes without the Crash Reporter appearing, we need your help![/h4]

Please manually submit your crash logs to us by following these steps:

[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Steam library and go to the Legacy: Steel & Sorcery page
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/712a0a44b0a5c63b77b6d7b66d9358b5c5f645ac.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Click the ⚙️ Manage button top right under the Legacy banner
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/d72553727fb46c2357593c35b2402343ebca412e.png[/img]


[list=1]
[*]Go to Manage → Browse local files
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/a3b53ebbd3d5218448ffa012dcb59d30846ee974.png[/img]


[list=1]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/76bff62ab0070d2305cf5936cf61d1677a737e98.png[/img]

[*]We will try to get back to you ASAP with assistance! We are a small team without a real support staff, so we appreciate your patience! 🧡
[/list]

[h1]Common Issue #2: "Unkown Error" (Unknown Error)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/2e7288aad7bc63bf8e6c40aec3c0b0650713327c.png[/img]

Other than being misspelled 😵, this error commonly is caused by your **connection being lost **because of a server connectivity issue that we are currently investigating.

We ask that you please retry to login after a few moments. If the issue is still occurring, please email support@playlegacy.gg, or open a [url=https://discord.com/channels/830738139789787147/1244409011491573800]📝 Discord Support Ticket[/url]

If this issue persists, please email support@playlegacy.gg, or open a [url=https://discord.com/channels/830738139789787147/1244409011491573800]📝 Discord Support Ticket[/url]

[h2]Unable to Connect to Steam[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/fb461256aa5e2e075fe310fe2fb51f7017cc74a6.png[/img]

If this issue persists, please email support@playlegacy.gg, or open a [url=https://discord.com/channels/830738139789787147/1244409011491573800]📝 Discord Support Ticket[/url]

notes.title: The Highlights of our AMA!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Yesterday, our CEO Chris headed over to r/Games for an Ask Me Anything on [i]Legacy: Steel & Sorcery[/i]. While we couldn't post every single questions and answers, we have picked some of the key questions and answers for you, so you can gain a little more insight into the game and what to expect. If you want to read all the questions and answers, with some about the studio and wider franchise, be sure to head on over to the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Games/comments/1iihi54/ama_im_chris_kaleiki_founder_ceo_of_notorious/]Subreddit[/url].

As a reminder, for all things Legacy related – join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlegacy]Discord[/url]!


[b]Q: How will the game ensure new players aren’t overwhelmed by veterans in PvP, and what’s the balance between skill and gear?[/b]
[list]
[*]The game includes hidden paths and traversal mechanics to help players avoid ganking, similar to Tarkov’s "rat" playstyle. Progression is more horizontal, focusing on perks rather than raw power to prevent veteran players from stomping newcomers.
[*]A new tutorial map, Goldbrook, will let players learn the game before entering PvP. The goal is for gear to matter around 60/40 or 70/30 compared to player skill.
[/list]
[b]Q: What’s the most surprising piece of feedback from playtests that led to a change in the game?[/b]
[list]
[*]The biggest surprise was the overwhelming demand for more PvE content, likely due to the studio’s WoW background.
[*]While PvE was always planned, the early demand led to prioritizing a tutorial map, onboarding systems, and a questline to help new players—something most hardcore PvP games don’t typically launch with.
[/list]
[b]Q: Any updates on a console release for Legacy?[/b]
[list]
[*]The plan is to bring Legacy to consoles around its gold master release or shortly after, with a target of early next year, depending on how Early Access performs. The team is also considering which console would be the best fit for launch.
[/list]
[b]Q: Any thoughts on an "Art of Legacy" book to showcase the game's visuals and lore?[/b]
[list]
[*]We will check with the team, but we're sure they'd love the idea and will pass along the suggestion.
[/list]
[b]Q: What lessons from working on World of Warcraft have you applied to Legacy: Steel & Sorcery? Also, what are your thoughts on the current state of WoW?[/b]
[list]
[*]We learned that real player choice in talent systems is often an illusion, as players will always pick the mathematically best option. In Legacy, we've applied this by making gear perks optimal based on conditions rather than just playstyle preference. 
[*]As for WoW, we still consider it a masterpiece and love that Blizzard has added Classic, Hardcore, and Season of Discovery to give players more options while staying true to the original vision.
[/list]
[b]Q: How does marketing budget allocation differ between AAA and indie studios, and how much has your studio spent on marketing?[/b]
[list]
[*]We classify ourselves as more of an AA studio, with a budget between $10M and $20M—far below the ~$200M typical for AAA. Marketing budgets are often equal to or half of a game's development cost, but for our Early Access launch, we're spending under $100K. The industry is shifting in how marketing works, and while streamers are often targeted, data suggests that just making a great game is the best approach for indie and AA titles.
[/list]
[b]Q: How does loot/gear progression work, and can average players get legendaries or uniques? Will low-geared players be wiped by experienced players in legendary gear?[/b]
[list]
[*]Players progress through gear tiers from "Junk" to "Legendary" items, which can be found through RNG or crafted by leveling up vendors and unlocking recipes. New players can obtain legendaries, but gear can be lost upon death. We aim to keep the power differential between low and high-geared players at around 50%, ensuring it's not too extreme, unlike some other PvP RPGs where it's much higher. The game features two maps at EA launch, with more coming soon to expand loot and progression.
[/list]
[b]Q: Can you share details about the upcoming Wizard and Paladin classes and their resource systems?[/b]
[list]
[*]The Wizard will focus on elemental interactions, such as combining Frost and Fire to create Fog, and will have a unique resource system tied to collecting spell scrolls found in the world. They will have the highest number of spells, and exploring the world for new spells will be key. The Paladin is still in paper design, but will have the ability to "Sense Injustice" in the world, identifying assassins and allowing them to seek vengeance. The Paladin will also be able to buff other players, a feature not yet available in the game.
[/list]
[b]Q: As a former backer of Crowfall, what is your game attempting to do differently?[/b]
[list]
[*]We are focusing on the core experience and combat fundamentals first, taking a Crawl/Walk/Run approach rather than trying to do everything at once like Crowfall. While Crowfall had great ideas, its ambition to build an MMO with complex systems and content overwhelmed the project. We’re opting to build over time, focusing on solid foundations before expanding.
[/list]
[b]Q: PvPvE / Extraction / RPG / with MMO elements. Can you explain how these elements reconcile in your game?[/b]
[list]
[*]The game blends Extraction with MMO-like features such as open-world areas, rich crafting, progression, and character customization. While it's focused on PvPvE, there are systems like quests and character creation common in MMOs. We aim to add more MMO features over time, including more PvE experiences and deeper character customization. The blend of "get in, get loot, and leave" with ongoing progression makes it unique. However, I don’t like genres or tags as they don’t fully capture what the game is trying to do.
[/list]
[b]Q: Is this game zone-based or more like The Division with open world public event areas? How does the gameplay structure work?[/b]
[list]
[*] The game features large, sandbox-like zones within session-based maps. It's not a linear level; players can explore and loot freely within the zone. While we do want to eventually explore the idea of moving between zones, the current focus is on massive, single-session maps. Implementing seamless zone transitions is challenging, especially with Unreal, but it's something we might consider later.
[/list]
[b]Q: Is there a connection between the original name "Project Honor" and the mechanic of executing players, or what was the inspiration for the original name?[/b]
[list]
[*] The name "Project Honor" came from an early idea I had around honor-based mechanics, though it wasn't directly tied to executions. The idea was more about giving players the choice in whether to kill others, similar to world PvP zones in MMOs. The game's name evolved to "Legacy," but the concept of honor remains in how players can choose whether to kill or let others live. As for the execution mechanic, it reflects a culture of "honor" and "dishonor" in combat, with plans to let players customize execution animations in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest #3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Alpha Playtest #3, Adventurers! [/h1]

[h2]TL;DR[/h2]

[list]
[*] In this build we are introducing more of the Lodge progression systems, we've revamped how Stash tabs work with containers you can craft and find to expand the tab size, changed how the Toolbelt works and introduced many more items and ingredients for crafting.
[*] On classes, we've toned down the Longbow and Priest in general. We also made some adjustments to the Warrior and Rogue to make them a bit better at solo PvE.
[*] As always, more art and sound have been introduced for Class Set items, VFX, and Greenwood.
[*] ⚠️ Unfortunately there are still some bugs that will make it into the build since we're in Alpha, please see the [b]Known Bugs[/b] section for a list of those.
[/list]

[h2]💖 Featured Changes[/h2]

🍳 [b]Cooking Pot (Lodge)[/b]
The Lodge now has the Cooking pot enabled. In order to unlock the Cooking pot, players must pay 100 Gold. (This will likely change in the future). Cooking allows you to combine ingredients to gain buffs to your Health, Stamina, and more. Finally Pumpkins are useful!

🛏️ [b]The Bed (Lodge)[/b]
The Lodge now features the Bed furnishing which allows you to gain Rested Experience while offline. This bonus applies to all of your characters in your House (account).

📦 [b]Stash Containers[/b]
We have redesigned the Stash tab system to allow players to customize the size of the Stash tab. Players can craft Stash Containers at the Workbench to increase the capacity of the tabs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046821/864af2a49f4801792fe335828029cf42f1b6d1d3.png[/img]
[i]Tip: You can also find a Barrel Stash Container in a.... well, take a guess![/i]

🎒 [b]New Toolbelt Design[/b]
We have converted the Toolbelt system over to our ultimate vision which is for both the regular consumable Toolbelt and Class Toolbelt (Priest Prayer Box, Hunter Quiver, Warrior Weapon Harness and Rogue Bag of Tricks) to have their own inventory space. This means that potions and those huge spears put in these new toolbelts don't take up space in your main bag! In a future patch we will also restrict players from being able to bring in any other items in their backpacks, so choosing which consumables and class tools will matter as well as progressing the size of your toolbelts through crafting will matter. (Think of them as loadouts)

In the previous design of the toolbelt, players could hotkey a specific tool or consumable and it would always consume that tool or consumable no matter what bag it was in (we call this Slot Memory). We do intend to bring this functionality back with the new version.

Larger toolbelts can be crafted at the Tailor, starting at level 2.

🧝‍♂️ [b]New Character Creation Experience[/b]
We are starting to put in new UI/UX for character creation. House Sigils that you can select and customize are coming at a later time. Let us know what you think!

👣 [b]Footstep Sounds![/b]
There are new footstep sounds that change depending on surface such as Dirt, Stone, Moss, Water and more! Let us know what you think.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🗒️ General Changes[/h2]
⚡ [b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Add frame gen option to setting menu used fidelity FX frame gen if DLSS is not supported.
[/list]
💞 [b]Matchmaking[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Region Selector on Login for matchmaking.
[/list]
⚔️ [b]Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Many more improvements have been made to Projectiles to improve their responsiveness on the client/server
[*] There are new animations for when players raise others from being Downed
[*] Guard break stun time reduced to 2 seconds on players, still lasts for 4 seconds on PVE enemies
[/list]

[h2]🧙‍♀️ Classes[/h2]

[h3]Warrior[/h3]

[quote=Developers]The Warrior is feeling in a good spot, but we feel and heard feedback that he's tough to solo especially in PvE. We have introduced a new Trait called "Pain Management" that grants the Warrior an absorb every time he casts an Enrage ability (Enrage, Rampage and Enraging Shout). We have also toned down the amount of "Block damage" all creatures in the game deal, which helps the Warrior the most.[/quote]
[expand type=details expanded=false]
[b]Iron Grip[/b]
[list]
[*] Charge up time increased to 1.5 seconds
[*] Stun time now has two levels
[list]
[*] Fully charged - 2 seconds of stun
[*] Less than a full charge - 1 seconds of stun[/list]
[*] Distance the chain travels has two levels
[*] Fully charged - 25 meters
[*] Less than a full charge - 10 meters[/list]
[b]Charge[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer guard breaks
[*] Now does 2 guard damage[/list]
[b]Rampage[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage is based on ability power so all weapons will result in the same damage
[*] No longer has the Unstoppable state[/list]
[b]Enrage[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced cost to 20 rage
[*] Reduced cooldown to 4 seconds
[*] Reduced duration to 2 seconds
[*] Fixed the enrage state to keep the player immune to all CC's for it's duration[/list]
[b]Mace + Shield[/b]
[list]
[*] LMB Charged Attack
[list]
[*] Hold time increased to 2 seconds
[*] Fully charged is Unblockable
[*] No longer breaks guard[/list]
[*] Quake (Q) now has Unstoppable, preventing the Warrior from being Staggered during its cast
[*] Shield Rush (Left Click while holding Right Click) now will be more responsive at Shield Breaking enemies
[*] You now block during Shield Rush
[*] New Jump attack animation
[/list]
[b]Spear[/b]
[list]
[*] Spear damage is now determined by ability power[/list]
[b]*New* Trait - Pain Management[/b]
[list]
[*] When you become Enraged, you absorb all damage equal to 15% of your maximum health. This effect ends when the Enrage ends.[/list]
[/expand]
[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[quote=Developers]We intend for the Longbow to give the Hunter a unique sniper experience not found in many Fantasy RPGs. However, the last patch made the Longbow a bit too lethal. We did some adjustments in this patch to tone it down. It make take a while until the vision is fully realized through some iteration.

Our vision for the Swiftbow is for it to be good against melee in PvP. It's best against multiple targets, where the Hunter can generate Swiftness using Wild Volley (Press and Hold) faster than other bows. The Tornado Volley (Q) is also intended to get melee off the Hunter, and so we improved its knockback effectiveness. 

The Shockbeetle had significant adjustments to give it some counterplay.[/quote]
[expand type=details expanded=false]
[list]
[*] Charged Shots now have "glint" VFX that give a tell to players
[*] Arrow hit detection is now more precise, and headshots are more consistent.
[list]
[*] [i]NOTE: Headshots previously were not functioning in the last build, and now again properly function. Headshots deal 200% of Normal damage.[/i] [/list] [/list]
[list] [*] New Elemental Arrow: Sentinel Arrow - Shoot a Sentinel Arrow into the sky, summoning your Sentinel to fly above. The Sentinel will alert you when enemies come near.
[list] [*] NOTE: Sentinel Arrow is an experimental ability that acts as a sentry totem. Use it in high traffic areas to know when enemies are coming near so you can attack, or use it defensively to be alerted when potential players at dungeon entrances. The Sentinel Arrow can be crafted at the Workbench. [/list] [/list]
[b]Explosive Seed[/b]
[list]
[*] Now deals 2 block damage, up from 1
[/list]
[b]Sporebomb[/b]
[list]
[*] Lasts 8 seconds
[*] Radius reduced by 50%
[/list]
[b]Flying Seed[/b]
[list]
[*] Now acts a proximity mine, detonating when enemies come near
[/list]
[b]Bramble Trap[/b]
[list]
[*] Snare is only applied while you are in the trap
[/list]
[b]Bear Trap[/b]
[b]Fixed an issue preventing the hunter from casting bear trap while sprinting[/b]
[b]Shockbeetle[/b]
[list]
[*] Now costs 40 energy to use
[*] No longer breaks block
[*] The Shockbeetle can now be killed
[*] Now has a proper animation when burrowing and unburrowing.
[/list]
[b]Sentinel Cyclone[/b]
[list]
[*] Now has new VFX
[*] Friendly Players who jump within the Cyclone leap into the air further
[/list]
[b]Swiftbow[/b]
[list]
[*] Now has a new sound!
[*] Wild Arrow (Normals) have a new VFX missile matching the Wild Volley.
[*] Wild Arrow Volley (Press and Hold) now deals more damage, but takes longer to cast.
[*] Tornado Volley (Q) now knocks back players further and travels longer
[*] Windstrike (Right Click Combo) now deals more Block damage, which can be useful on Shield Skeletons in particular
[/list]
[b]Longbow[/b]
[list]
[*] Now has a new sound!
[*] Damage reduced by 10%
[*] Eagle Stance (Q)
[list] [*] Bonus damage now requires Swiftness. Each Charged Shot consumes up to 20 Swiftness, increasing its damage by 10% for each.
[*] [i]NOTE: You can passively gain Swiftness with the Longbow by having your reticle over a target while charging a shot.[/i] [/list]
[*] The "Swift Disengage" perk now generates 1 Swiftness, reduced from 3.
[/list]
[/expand]
[h3]Rogue[/h3]
[quote=Developers]The Rogue is intended to be the more technical of the current playable classes, but we do agree some of that extra skill required doesn't always pay off. We've redesigned the Claw suite of abilities to give the Rogue the unique strength of applying one of the many Afflictions in the game (Poison, Disease and Hemorrhage). This will help the Rogues sustained damage and effectiveness, especially in PvE.

The Rogue has a bit too much control, even in this patch, and we will be doing some tweaks in the future to address that (especially with Phantom Dagger).[/quote]
[expand type=details expanded=false]
[b]Evade[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the rogue's evade distance was getting reduced by goblin Tar Trap snares
[/list]
[b]Adrenaline[/b]
[list]
[*] Doubled the rate that adrenaline regenerates to 20 per second
[/list]
[b]Claw Attack abilities have been redesigned:[/b]
[list]
[*] Serrated Claw: Instantly strikes the target, causing Hemorrhage buildup and causes all of your Normal weapon attacks to deal Hemorrhage buildup for 6 sec.
[*] Poisoned Claw: Instantly strikes the target, causing Poison buildup and causes all Normal weapon attacks to deal Poison buildup for 6 sec.
[*] Infected Claw: Instantly strikes the target, causing Disease buildup and causes all Normal weapon attacks to deal Poison buildup for 6 sec.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Visage now has a new look!
[/list]
[b]Phantom Dagger[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectile Speed increased by 25% back to it's original value
[*] Attempted Fix for an issue where trying to teleport to a Hunter on a trap would result in the rogue not teleporting and instead getting rooted in place.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Teleporting from Visage and Phantom Dagger removes all Root effects.
[/list]
[b]Stealth[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed many VFX showing during stealth including: Footstep clouds, sprint lines, potion healing, and priest holy shield bubble
[*] PvE creatures now treat stealth differently, the Rogue will be detectable if the Player is very close and in front of the enemy
[/list]
[b]Invisibility (NOTE: [i]Invisibility occurs for a short duration when Shroud and Phantom Veil are used[/i])[/b]
[list]
[*] Removes all roots
[*] Causes PVE mobs to not know where the rogue is for the duration, if line of sight is broken during invisibility the enemy will lose aggro
[/list]
[b]Creep[/b]
[list]
[*] Creep costs more stamina per second now when sprinting
